character.name: Ada
character.current_goal: Determine what the public-history panel can responsibly say about when the old quay was raised.
established_knowledge: READING_ROOM, PUBLIC_QUAY, and MAP_INDEX are explored.
SEALED_STORE is only rumored/administratively unavailable and has not been entered.
Ada has access to public map editions, indexed maintenance summaries, and visible tide marks.
prohibited_knowledge: Ada does not know the contents of SEALED_STORE.
Ada does not know whether unavailable archive boxes contain decisive evidence.

local_areas.summary: Public archive reading room with map reproductions and indexed records.
Accessible old quay with two visible tide/height marks from different periods.
Public index of dated municipal map editions.
Unavailable storage area outside current research access; its contents remain unknown.

current_facts: The draft exhibit panel currently names 1962 as the year the quay was raised.
A 1961 map edition still shows the earlier quay profile.
A 1964 maintenance index refers to repairs at the 'raised west quay'.
Two physical tide-height marks differ in style and elevation, but neither carries a clear year.
hidden_facts_not_available_to_story: No canonical record establishes one exact construction date.

opportunity.title: Correct the public account of the old quay
opportunity.premise: Ada can reconcile public maps, maintenance indexes, and physical tide marks to improve the exhibit without claiming an unsupported exact date.
opportunity.success_condition: Produce a better-supported public interpretation and explicitly preserve remaining date uncertainty.
constraints: Do not invent unavailable document contents.
Do not convert an interpretation into an exact fact without evidence.
Do not let a supervisor solve the research problem.

hard_rules: Character knowledge cannot exceed experienced or explicitly communicated records.
RUMORED or unavailable locations are not EXPLORED.
Interpretive claims must preserve their epistemic class.

eligible_context: Ada is improving public-history material by separating documented facts from responsible interpretation.
forbidden_reveal: Do not reveal a future archive acquisition or SEALED_STORE contents.

relevant_memories.summary: Ada previously corrected a caption after discovering that a later summary had compressed two separate events into one date.
relevant_memories.relevance: Supports caution around simplified public-history narratives.
